x-scraper.name: mcp__x-scraper__search_x
x-scraper.description:
Search X (Twitter) for tweets matching keywords.

Args:
    keywords: List of search keywords (e.g. ["AI", "Claude", "Anthropic"])
    days: How many days back to search (default: 3)
    limit: Maximum number of tweets to return (default: None = use built-in cap)

Returns:
    JSON array of tweet results with title, url, engagement, etc. 【いつ呼ぶか】X(Twitter)の投稿検索・トレンド・特定ポスト取得が必要なときに呼ぶ。速報・一次情報・現場の声を拾う用途に向く。

x-scraper.name: mcp__x-scraper__get_x_trends
x-scraper.description:
Get current trending topics on X (Twitter) in Japan.

Args:
    limit: Maximum number of trends to return (default: None = all)

Returns:
    JSON array of trending topic names. 【いつ呼ぶか】X(Twitter)の投稿検索・トレンド・特定ポスト取得が必要なときに呼ぶ。速報・一次情報・現場の声を拾う用途に向く。

x-scraper.name: mcp__x-scraper__get_tweet
x-scraper.description:
Get a single tweet by URL, including text, engagement metrics, and media (image/video) URLs.

Args:
    tweet_url: Full tweet URL (e.g. "https://x.com/user/status/123456789")

Returns:
    JSON object with tweet text, author, engagement, and media_urls. 【いつ呼ぶか】X(Twitter)の投稿検索・トレンド・特定ポスト取得が必要なときに呼ぶ。速報・一次情報・現場の声を拾う用途に向く。

x-scraper.name: mcp__x-scraper__search_x_with_trends
x-scraper.description:
Get X trends and search tweets for each trending topic.

Args:
    days: How many days back to search (default: 3)
    limit: Maximum number of tweets to return (default: None = use built-in cap)

Returns:
    JSON array of tweet results from trending topics. 【いつ呼ぶか】X(Twitter)の投稿検索・トレンド・特定ポスト取得が必要なときに呼ぶ。速報・一次情報・現場の声を拾う用途に向く。

nikkei-indexes.name: mcp__nikkei-indexes__get_index_history
nikkei-indexes.description:
日経公式CSVから指数の日足OHLCを取得する。

Args:
    idx: インデックスキー ("vi"=日経VI, "nikkei"=日経平均)。
         一覧は list_known_indexes で確認。
    days: 直近何営業日分を返すか (1〜2000, 既定30)。

Returns:
    JSON: {index, label, bars: [{date, open, high, low, close}...],
           source, cache, note} 【いつ呼ぶか】日経平均・日経VI・国内株価指数の現在値/履歴/VIシグナルを聞かれたら呼ぶ。

nikkei-indexes.name: mcp__nikkei-indexes__check_vi_signal
nikkei-indexes.description:
日経VI平均回帰戦略の発火3条件を最新の確報データで判定する。

条件 (全て同時成立で fire):
  1. VI始値 >= base (恐怖の高原, 既定30)
  2. VI終値 > VI始値 (日中に恐怖が発生)
  3. 日経終値 < 日経始値 (株価が日中に崩れる)

Args:
    base: VI始値の閾値 (既定30.0)。

Returns:
    JSON: {data_date, base, vi: OHLC, nikkei: OHLC,
           conditions: {3条件のboolean}, fire,
           is_latest_business_day, stale_note?, strategy_note} 【いつ呼ぶか】日経平均・日経VI・国内株価指数の現在値/履歴/VIシグナルを聞かれたら呼ぶ。

nikkei-indexes.name: mcp__nikkei-indexes__list_known_indexes
nikkei-indexes.description: 動作確認済みの日経公式CSV一覧 (キー・ラベル・URL) を返す。 【いつ呼ぶか】日経平均・日経VI・国内株価指数の現在値/履歴/VIシグナルを聞かれたら呼ぶ。

yfj-quote.name: mcp__yfj-quote__get_quote
yfj-quote.description:
Yahoo Finance Japan から銘柄/指数/為替の現在値を取得する。

Args:
    code: 銘柄コード。例: "7203.T" (トヨタ), "998407.O" (日経平均),
          "998405.T" (TOPIX), "USDJPY=X" (ドル円), "^DJI" (NYダウ),
          "AAPL" (アップル), "NVDA" (エヌビディア)。米国株/海外株は
          query1 の chart backbone から取得し currency に "USD" 等が入る。
          コードが不明なら先に search_ticker を使う。

Returns:
    JSON: {name, code, market, currency, price, change, change_rate_pct,
           previous_close, open, high, low, volume,
           market_cap_million_yen, update_time_jp, source, cache}
    米国株は currency="USD"、market_cap_million_yen は null。 【いつ呼ぶか】個別株・ETF・為替レートの現在値/履歴（Yahoo Finance Japan）やFisco VIニュースが必要なときに呼ぶ。

yfj-quote.name: mcp__yfj-quote__search_ticker
yfj-quote.description:
Yahoo Finance Japan の銘柄検索。銘柄名から証券コード候補を返す。

Args:
    query: 銘柄名・キーワード (例: "トヨタ", "ソニー", "Apple")。
           米国株も結果に含まれる (例: "Apple" → AAPL / NASDAQ)。

Returns:
    JSON: {query, results: [{code, name, market, price, price_change,
           link}...]} — code はそのまま get_quote に渡せる。 【いつ呼ぶか】個別株・ETF・為替レートの現在値/履歴（Yahoo Finance Japan）やFisco VIニュースが必要なときに呼ぶ。

yfj-quote.name: mcp__yfj-quote__get_price_history
yfj-quote.description:
銘柄/指数/為替の日足等のヒストリカルOHLCを取得する（グラフ描画用）。

現在値は get_quote、こちらは時系列。Yahoo の chart バックボーン
(key不要) から取得する。code は get_quote と同じものが渡せる。

Args:
    code: 銘柄コード。例 "6501.T" (日立), "7203.T", "USDJPY=X"。
          国内指数 "998407.O"(日経平均) は内部で ^N225 に対応付ける。
    range: 期間。1mo/3mo/6mo/1y/2y/5y/10y/max (既定 6mo)。
    interval: 足。1d/1wk/1mo (既定 1d)。

Returns:
    JSON: {code, symbol, currency, count, range, interval,
           bars: [{date, open, high, low, close, volume}...],
           source, cache, note?} 【いつ呼ぶか】個別株・ETF・為替レートの現在値/履歴（Yahoo Finance Japan）やFisco VIニュースが必要なときに呼ぶ。

yfj-quote.name: mcp__yfj-quote__get_fisco_vi_news
yfj-quote.description:
日経VIのザラ場速報をフィスコ記事 (Yahoo配信) から取得する。

日経公式CSVは前営業日確定値のみなので、当日日中のVI水準はこれが
唯一の無料経路。最新の「日経VI：…」記事から現在値・前日比・
高値・安値を抽出して返す。

Returns:
    JSON (成功): {found: true, headline, article_time, article_url,
                  vi_current, vi_change, direction, vi_high, vi_low,
                  partial?}
    JSON (失敗): {found: false, stage, reason, fallback} 【いつ呼ぶか】個別株・ETF・為替レートの現在値/履歴（Yahoo Finance Japan）やFisco VIニュースが必要なときに呼ぶ。

polymarket.name: mcp__polymarket__search_markets
polymarket.description:
キーワードで Polymarket の予測市場を検索する。

Args:
    query: キーワード (例: "iran", "taiwan", "fed rate", "hormuz")。

Returns:
    JSON: {query, events:[{event_id, title, slug,
           markets:[{question, slug, yes_price, volume, volume_24h,
           liquidity, end_date, closed, active, clob_token_ids}...]}],
           cache}
    slug は get_market / get_market_history にそのまま渡せる。 【いつ呼ぶか】予測市場（Polymarket）のオッズ・確率・マーケット情報を聞かれたら呼ぶ。選挙・経済イベント・スポーツ等の発生確率の参照に向く。

polymarket.name: mcp__polymarket__get_market
polymarket.description:
slug で特定市場の現在の確率・出来高・流動性・期限・解決基準を取得する。

Args:
    slug: 市場の slug (search_markets の結果から)。

Returns:
    JSON: {question, slug, yes_price(=Yes確率0-1), volume, volume_24h,
           liquidity, end_date, closed, active, clob_token_ids,
           resolution(=解決基準), source, cache} 【いつ呼ぶか】予測市場（Polymarket）のオッズ・確率・マーケット情報を聞かれたら呼ぶ。選挙・経済イベント・スポーツ等の発生確率の参照に向く。

polymarket.name: mcp__polymarket__get_market_history
polymarket.description:
slug で Yes 確率の時系列を取得する（グラフ・変化検出用）。

Args:
    slug: 市場の slug。
    interval: 1h/6h/1d/1w/1m/max (既定 1m=1ヶ月)。

Returns:
    JSON: {slug, question, interval, count,
           points:[{t(unix), date(iso), price(0-1)}...], source, cache} 【いつ呼ぶか】予測市場（Polymarket）のオッズ・確率・マーケット情報を聞かれたら呼ぶ。選挙・経済イベント・スポーツ等の発生確率の参照に向く。

minkabu-fx.name: mcp__minkabu-fx__get_orderbook
minkabu-fx.description:
みんかぶFXから注文(指値/逆指値)の価格帯別分布を取得する。get_quote 相当。

「未約定の注文がどの価格に溜まっているか」= 売り壁・買い指値の山の生データ。
成行(price=0)と末尾センチネルは除去済み、価格昇順。解析済みの要約が欲しいなら
analyze_orderbook を使う。

Args:
    instrument: 通貨ペア。例 "USD_JPY"(ドル円), "EUR_USD", "XAU_USD"(金)。
                "usdjpy" / "USD/JPY" 表記も受け付ける。対応は list_instruments。

Returns:
    JSON: {instrument, type:"order", bucket_width, current_price,
           last_update, long_percent, short_percent,
           buckets:[{price, long_pct, short_pct}...], raw_count,
           kept_count, source, cache}
    非対応/データ無し: {error, detail, instrument, type, hint} 【いつ呼ぶか】FX（ドル円等）のオーダーブック・注文状況・為替介入の観測が必要なときに呼ぶ。

minkabu-fx.name: mcp__minkabu-fx__get_positions
minkabu-fx.description:
みんかぶFXから建玉(ロング/ショート)の価格帯別分布を取得する。

「既存ポジションがどの価格に溜まっているか」= 踏み上げ/投げ売り燃料の生データ。
建玉には現在値から遠い古い価格帯(例: ドル円の76〜78円台)が残るので、近辺だけ
見たいなら analyze_orderbook (現在値±N にズーム) を使う。

Args:
    instrument: 通貨ペア。例 "USD_JPY", "EUR_JPY"。list_instruments 参照。

Returns:
    JSON: {instrument, type:"position", bucket_width, current_price,
           last_update, long_percent, short_percent,
           buckets:[{price, long_pct, short_pct}...], raw_count,
           kept_count, source, cache} 【いつ呼ぶか】FX（ドル円等）のオーダーブック・注文状況・為替介入の観測が必要なときに呼ぶ。

minkabu-fx.name: mcp__minkabu-fx__list_instruments
minkabu-fx.description:
みんかぶFXオーダーブックが対応する通貨ペア一覧を返す。

ハードコードした既知リスト (2026-06-24 実測)。NZD_JPY / CAD_JPY は非対応
(HTTP 500)。XAU_USD(金) はルートはあるが時間帯によって空のことがある。

Returns:
    JSON: {instruments:[...], count, note} 【いつ呼ぶか】FX（ドル円等）のオーダーブック・注文状況・為替介入の観測が必要なときに呼ぶ。

minkabu-fx.name: mcp__minkabu-fx__analyze_orderbook
minkabu-fx.description:
注文+建玉を現在値付近にズームし、売り壁/買いの山/踏み上げ燃料を構造化して返す。

2026-06-24 に手作業でやったバタフライ分析のツール化。注文(order)と建玉
(position)の両方を1発で取り、現在値 ±radius に絞ってピークを抽出する。
「ドル円のショートどこに固まってる?」「162に売り壁ある?」に即答する用。

解釈:
  - order.above (上の short 指値/逆指値) = 売り壁・抵抗
  - order.below (下の long 指値) = 買いの山・支持
  - position.above (上の short 建玉) = 踏み上げ燃料 (上昇で買い戻しが入る)
  - position.below (下の long 建玉) = 投げ売り燃料
distance は price - current_price (符号付き、正=現在値より上)。

Args:
    instrument: 通貨ペア。例 "USD_JPY", "XAU_USD"。
    radius: 現在値からのズーム半径(価格単位)。省略時は bucket_width*40 で自動
            (ドル円なら ±2.0円程度)。広く見たいなら明示で渡す。

Returns:
    JSON: {instrument, current_price, last_update, bucket_width,
           zoom_radius,
           order:{long_percent, short_percent, above:[...], below:[...]},
           position:{long_percent, short_percent, above:[...], below:[...]},
           signals:[...], sources, cache}
    order/position 片方が空でも、取れた方だけ返す (もう片方は null + reason)。 【いつ呼ぶか】FX（ドル円等）のオーダーブック・注文状況・為替介入の観測が必要なときに呼ぶ。

brave-search.name: mcp__brave-search__brave_web_search
brave-search.description:
Performs web searches using the Brave Search API and returns comprehensive search results with rich metadata.

    When to use:
        - General web searches for information, facts, or current topics
        - Location-based queries (restaurants, businesses, points of interest)
        - News searches for recent events or breaking stories
        - Finding videos, discussions, or FAQ content
        - Research requiring diverse result types (web pages, images, reviews, etc.)

    Returns a JSON list of web results with title, description, and URL.
    
    When the "results_filter" parameter is empty, JSON results may also contain FAQ, Discussions, News, and Video results. 日本語のクエリでは country='JP', search_lang='jp', ui_lang='ja-JP' を明示的に指定すること（省略するとUS/英語の検索結果になる）。 【いつ呼ぶか】Web検索が必要なとき（ニュース・時事・技術情報・一般調査）に呼ぶ。

country.description: Search query country, where the results come from. The country string is limited to 2 character country codes of supported countries.

search_lang.description: Search language preference. The 2 or more character language code for which the search results are provided.

ui_lang.description: The language of the UI. The 2 or more character language code for which the search results are provided.

count.description: Number of results (1-20, default 10). Applies only to web search results (i.e., has no effect on locations, news, videos, etc.)

safesearch.description: Filters search results for adult content. The following values are supported: 'off' - No filtering. 'moderate' - Filters explicit content (e.g., images and videos), but allows adult domains in search results. 'strict' - Drops all adult content from search results. The default value is 'moderate'.

freshness.description: Filters search results by when they were discovered. The following values are supported: 'pd' - Discovered within the last 24 hours. 'pw' - Discovered within the last 7 days. 'pm' - Discovered within the last 31 days. 'py' - Discovered within the last 365 days. 'YYYY-MM-DDtoYYYY-MM-DD' - Timeframe is also supported by specifying the date range e.g. 2022-04-01to2022-07-30.

text_decorations.description: Whether display strings (e.g. result snippets) should include decoration markers (e.g. highlighting characters).

spellcheck.description: Whether to spellcheck the provided query.

goggles.description: Goggles act as a custom re-ranking on top of Brave's search index. The parameter supports both a url where the Goggle is hosted or the definition of the Goggle. For more details, refer to the Goggles repository (i.e., https://github.com/brave/goggles-quickstart).

units.description: The measurement units. If not provided, units are derived from search country.

extra_snippets.description: A snippet is an excerpt from a page you get as a result of the query, and extra_snippets allow you to get up to 5 additional, alternative excerpts. Only available under Free AI, Base AI, Pro AI, Base Data, Pro Data and Custom plans.

summary.description: This parameter enables summary key generation in web search results. This is required for summarizer to be enabled.

brave-search.name: mcp__brave-search__brave_local_search
brave-search.description:
Brave Local Search API provides enrichments for location search results. Access to this API is available only through the Brave Search API Pro plans; confirm the user's plan before using this tool (if the user does not have a Pro plan, use the brave_web_search tool). Searches for local businesses and places using Brave's Local Search API. Best for queries related to physical locations, businesses, restaurants, services, etc.
    
    Returns detailed information including:
        - Business names and addresses
        - Ratings and review counts
        - Phone numbers and opening hours

    Use this when the query implies 'near me', 'in my area', or mentions specific locations (e.g., 'in San Francisco'). This tool automatically falls back to brave_web_search if no local results are found. 日本語のクエリでは country='JP', search_lang='jp', ui_lang='ja-JP' を明示的に指定すること（省略するとUS/英語の検索結果になる）。 【いつ呼ぶか】Web検索が必要なとき（ニュース・時事・技術情報・一般調査）に呼ぶ。

country.description: Search query country, where the results come from. The country string is limited to 2 character country codes of supported countries.

search_lang.description: Search language preference. The 2 or more character language code for which the search results are provided.

ui_lang.description: The language of the UI. The 2 or more character language code for which the search results are provided.

count.description: Number of results (1-20, default 10). Applies only to web search results (i.e., has no effect on locations, news, videos, etc.)

safesearch.description: Filters search results for adult content. The following values are supported: 'off' - No filtering. 'moderate' - Filters explicit content (e.g., images and videos), but allows adult domains in search results. 'strict' - Drops all adult content from search results. The default value is 'moderate'.

freshness.description: Filters search results by when they were discovered. The following values are supported: 'pd' - Discovered within the last 24 hours. 'pw' - Discovered within the last 7 days. 'pm' - Discovered within the last 31 days. 'py' - Discovered within the last 365 days. 'YYYY-MM-DDtoYYYY-MM-DD' - Timeframe is also supported by specifying the date range e.g. 2022-04-01to2022-07-30.

text_decorations.description: Whether display strings (e.g. result snippets) should include decoration markers (e.g. highlighting characters).

spellcheck.description: Whether to spellcheck the provided query.

goggles.description: Goggles act as a custom re-ranking on top of Brave's search index. The parameter supports both a url where the Goggle is hosted or the definition of the Goggle. For more details, refer to the Goggles repository (i.e., https://github.com/brave/goggles-quickstart).

units.description: The measurement units. If not provided, units are derived from search country.

extra_snippets.description: A snippet is an excerpt from a page you get as a result of the query, and extra_snippets allow you to get up to 5 additional, alternative excerpts. Only available under Free AI, Base AI, Pro AI, Base Data, Pro Data and Custom plans.

summary.description: This parameter enables summary key generation in web search results. This is required for summarizer to be enabled.

brave-search.name: mcp__brave-search__brave_video_search
brave-search.description:
Searches for videos using Brave's Video Search API and returns structured video results with metadata.

    When to use:
        - When you need to find videos related to a specific topic, keyword, or query.
        - Useful for discovering video content, getting video metadata, or finding videos from specific creators/publishers.

    Returns a JSON list of video-related results with title, url, description, duration, and thumbnail_url. 日本語のクエリでは country='JP', search_lang='jp', ui_lang='ja-JP' を明示的に指定すること（省略するとUS/英語の検索結果になる）。 【いつ呼ぶか】Web検索が必要なとき（ニュース・時事・技術情報・一般調査）に呼ぶ。

query.description: The user's search query. Query cannot be empty. Limited to 400 characters and 50 words.

country.description: Search query country, where the results come from. The country string is limited to 2 character country codes of supported countries.

search_lang.description: Search language preference. The 2 or more character language code for which the search results are provided.

ui_lang.description: User interface language preferred in response. Usually of the format <language_code>-<country_code>. For more, see RFC 9110.

count.description: Number of results (1-50, default 20). Combine this parameter with `offset` to paginate search results.

offset.description: Pagination offset (max 9, default 0). Combine this parameter with `count` to paginate search results.

safesearch.description: Filters search results for adult content. The following values are supported: 'off' - No filtering. 'moderate' - Filter out explicit content. 'strict' - Filter out explicit and suggestive content. The default value is 'moderate'.

freshness.description: Filters search results by when they were discovered. The following values are supported: 'pd' - Discovered within the last 24 hours. 'pw' - Discovered within the last 7 days. 'pm' - Discovered within the last 31 days. 'py' - Discovered within the last 365 days. 'YYYY-MM-DDtoYYYY-MM-DD' - timeframe is also supported by specifying the date range (e.g. '2022-04-01to2022-07-30').

brave-search.name: mcp__brave-search__brave_image_search
brave-search.description: Performs an image search using the Brave Search API. Helpful for when you need pictures of people, places, things, graphic design ideas, art inspiration, and more. When relaying results in a markdown environment, it may be helpful to include images in the results (e.g., ![image.title](image.properties.url)). 日本語のクエリでは country='JP', search_lang='jp', ui_lang='ja-JP' を明示的に指定すること（省略するとUS/英語の検索結果になる）。 【いつ呼ぶか】Web検索が必要なとき（ニュース・時事・技術情報・一般調査）に呼ぶ。

query.description: The user's search query. Query cannot be empty. Limited to 400 characters and 50 words.

country.description: Search query country, where the results come from. The country string is limited to 2 character country codes of supported countries.

search_lang.description: Search language preference. The 2 or more character language code for which the search results are provided.

count.description: Number of results (1-200, default 50). Combine this parameter with `offset` to paginate search results.

brave-search.name: mcp__brave-search__brave_news_search
brave-search.description:
This tool searches for news articles using Brave's News Search API based on the user's query. Use it when you need current news information, breaking news updates, or articles about specific topics, events, or entities.
    
    When to use:
        - Finding recent news articles on specific topics
        - Getting breaking news updates
        - Researching current events or trending stories
        - Gathering news sources and headlines for analysis

mem0.name: mcp__mem0__search
mem0.description:
Semantic search against the shared Mem0 long-term memory.

Returns a formatted block of relevant memories for the given query.
Use this when you want to recall facts about 先輩 (preferences,
past decisions, ongoing projects, personal details).

Plain vector search is the default. Pass `smart=True` for the higher-cost
pipeline that (1) rewrites the query into canonical-keyword variants via
Haiku, (2) runs multi-query parallel search, and (3) LLM-reranks the
merged candidates. Smart mode adds ~1-3 s of latency from two extra Haiku
round-trips; enable it only when default search misses what you need.

Each returned memory carries a `metadata` dict. Notable fields:
  - category / subcategory / tags : taxonomy from extract.py
  - importance (1-5) : reinforced by +1 on each duplicate hit
  - tier (0=Live, 1=Hot, 2=Warm, 3=Cold) : weekly_compact decay state
  - mention_count : Hebbian counter, bumped when a duplicate is ingested
  - reinforced_at (list[int]) / last_reinforced_at : reinforcement history
  - value_class : noise/transient/preference/decision/knowledge/episodic
  - created_at / created_at_unix : ingest time (when present)

Args:
    query: Natural language query describing what you want to recall.
    limit: Max number of memories to return (default 5).
    user_id: Mem0 user key. Defaults to 先輩's Discord ID so results
        are shared with the Discord bot.
    smart: When True, use rewriting+reranking pipeline. Adds ~2 Haiku
        calls of latency in exchange for higher hit rate. Default: False.

mem0.name: mcp__mem0__add
mem0.description:
Store a conversation turn so Mem0 can extract new long-term facts.

Mem0's LLM extractor (Claude Haiku via OAuth) will distill durable
facts from the exchange and store them keyed by user_id.

For richer extraction, pass recent conversation context (e.g. the
last few messages in the thread) via the `context` parameter. This
helps Mem0 pick up facts that only make sense in context.

Args:
    user_message: The user's message text.
    assistant_message: The assistant's reply text.
    user_id: Mem0 user key (default: 先輩's Discord ID).
    context: Optional recent conversation context to prepend.
        Include the last few messages leading up to this exchange
        so Mem0's extractor can understand the full conversational flow.

mem0.name: mcp__mem0__list_all
mem0.description:
List memories Mem0 holds for the given user (truncated to `limit`).

Use `search` for targeted lookups — list_all is for sampling/overview.

Each memory's `metadata` dict has the same shape as `search` returns
(category, importance, tier, mention_count, reinforced_at, value_class,
created_at_unix, …). See the `search` docstring for definitions.

Args:
    user_id: Mem0 user key (default: 先輩's Discord ID).
    limit: Max number of memories to return (default 50). The full
        count is huge; raise this only when you really need it.

mem0.name: mcp__mem0__delete
mem0.description:
Delete a specific memory by its Mem0 ID.

Only the owner of the memory (matched by user_id) can delete it.

Args:
    memory_id: The memory ID returned by `list_all` or `search`.
    user_id: Discord snowflake of the requesting user. Must match the
        user_id stored on the memory record.

context7.name: mcp__context7__resolve-library-id
context7.description:
Resolves a package/product name to a Context7-compatible library ID and returns matching libraries.

You MUST call this function before 'Query Documentation' tool to obtain a valid Context7-compatible library ID UNLESS the user explicitly provides a library ID in the format '/org/project' or '/org/project/version' in their query.

Each result includes:
- Library ID: Context7-compatible identifier (format: /org/project)
- Name: Library or package name
- Description: Short summary
- Code Snippets: Number of available code examples
- Source Reputation: Authority indicator (High, Medium, Low, or Unknown)
- Benchmark Score: Quality indicator (100 is the highest score)
- Versions: List of versions if available. Use one of those versions if the user provides a version in their query. The format of the version is /org/project/version.

For best results, select libraries based on name match, source reputation, snippet coverage, benchmark score, and relevance to your use case.

Selection Process:
1. Analyze the query to understand what library/package the user is looking for
2. Return the most relevant match based on:
- Name similarity to the query (exact matches prioritized)
- Description relevance to the query's intent
- Documentation coverage (prioritize libraries with higher Code Snippet counts)
- Source reputation (consider libraries with High or Medium reputation more authoritative)
- Benchmark Score: Quality indicator (100 is the highest score)

Response Format:
- Return the selected library ID in a clearly marked section
- Provide a brief explanation for why this library was chosen
- If multiple good matches exist, acknowledge this but proceed with the most relevant one
- If no good matches exist, clearly state this and suggest query refinements

For ambiguous queries, request clarification before proceeding with a best-guess match.

IMPORTANT: Do not call this tool more than 3 times per question. If you cannot find what you need after 3 calls, use the best result you have. 【いつ呼ぶか】ライブラリ/フレームワークの公式ドキュメント・APIリファレンスを正確に参照したいときに呼ぶ。

query.description: The question or task you need help with. This is used to rank library results by relevance to what the user is trying to accomplish. The query is sent to the Context7 API for processing. Do not include any sensitive or confidential information such as API keys, passwords, credentials, personal data, or proprietary code in your query.

libraryName.description: Library name to search for and retrieve a Context7-compatible library ID. Use the official library name with proper punctuation — e.g., 'Next.js' instead of 'nextjs', 'Customer.io' instead of 'customerio', 'Three.js' instead of 'threejs'.

context7.name: mcp__context7__query-docs
context7.description:
Retrieves and queries up-to-date documentation and code examples from Context7 for any programming library or framework.

You must call 'Resolve Context7 Library ID' tool first to obtain the exact Context7-compatible library ID required to use this tool, UNLESS the user explicitly provides a library ID in the format '/org/project' or '/org/project/version' in their query.

Do not call this tool more than 3 times per question. 【いつ呼ぶか】ライブラリ/フレームワークの公式ドキュメント・APIリファレンスを正確に参照したいときに呼ぶ。

libraryId.description: Exact Context7-compatible library ID (e.g., '/mongodb/docs', '/vercel/next.js', '/supabase/supabase', '/vercel/next.js/v14.3.0-canary.87') retrieved from 'resolve-library-id' or directly from user query in the format '/org/project' or '/org/project/version'.

query.description: The question or task you need help with. Be specific and include relevant details. Good: 'How to set up authentication with JWT in Express.js' or 'React useEffect cleanup function examples'. Bad: 'auth' or 'hooks'. The query is sent to the Context7 API for processing. Do not include any sensitive or confidential information such as API keys, passwords, credentials, personal data, or proprietary code in your query.

realestate.name: mcp__realestate__search_suumo
realestate.description:
[REQUIRED FOR ANY REAL ESTATE QUERY] SUUMO 賃貸物件の実データ検索.

東京 (目黒区 / 世田谷区 / 品川区 / 大田区) の賃貸物件・家賃・間取り・
駅徒歩を聞かれたら **このツールを必ず呼ぶ**. キャッシュ + rate limit
厳守済みなので呼び出しコストは低い.

DO NOT:
    - 物件名・家賃・住所を推測したり過去の知識から答えたりしない
    - "おすすめ" "好み" "向いてる物件" 系の質問でも、まず実データを取得してから語る
    - search_homes と併用するときは両方呼ぶ (片方だけだとカバレッジ不足)

Args:
    area: 区名 ("目黒区" / "世田谷区" / "品川区" / "大田区" のみ対応)
    rent_min: 家賃下限 (円、月額). 例: 100000
    rent_max: 家賃上限 (円、月額). 例: 200000
    layout: 間取り ("1K" / "1DK" / "1LDK" / "2K" / "2DK" / "2LDK" / "3K" / "3DK" / "3LDK")
    walk_min: 駅徒歩分以内 (例: 10 で徒歩 10 分以内)
    limit: 最大取得件数 (default 20, max 30)

Returns:
    JSON {results: [Property...], from_cache: bool, count: int}.
    Property の各フィールド: url, title, rent_man_yen (家賃 万円),
    layout, area_m2, address, walk_minutes_min, built_age, image_urls 等. 【いつ呼ぶか】賃貸・不動産物件の検索（SUUMO/HOMES）が必要なときに呼ぶ。

realestate.name: mcp__realestate__search_homes
realestate.description:
[REQUIRED FOR ANY REAL ESTATE QUERY] HOMES (LIFULL HOME'S) 賃貸物件の実データ検索.

SUUMO と併せて呼ぶことで物件カバレッジが上がる. 東京の賃貸物件・家賃・
間取り・駅徒歩を聞かれたら **search_suumo と一緒にこれも呼ぶ**.

DO NOT:
    - 物件名・家賃・住所を推測したり過去の知識から答えたりしない
    - "おすすめ" "好み" "向いてる物件" 系の質問でも、まず実データを取得してから語る

Args:
    area: 区名 ("目黒区" / "世田谷区" / "品川区" / "大田区" のみ対応)
    rent_min: 家賃下限 (円、月額). HOMES は URL filter 非対応のため取得後にクライアント側で絞り込み
    rent_max: 家賃上限 (円、月額). 同上、後段絞り込み
    layout: 間取り ("1K" / "1DK" / "1LDK" / "ワンルーム" 等). 同上
    walk_min: 駅徒歩分以内. 同上
    limit: 最大取得件数 (default 20, max 30)

Returns:
    JSON {results: [Property...], from_cache: bool, count: int}.
    Property は search_suumo と同じ統一スキーマ. 【いつ呼ぶか】賃貸・不動産物件の検索（SUUMO/HOMES）が必要なときに呼ぶ。

realestate.name: mcp__realestate__get_property_detail
realestate.description:
[USE AFTER search_*] 物件 URL から詳細情報を cache 優先で取得する.

search_suumo / search_homes の結果に含まれる url を引数に渡す. cache 未ヒットなら
not_in_cache error を返すので、先に search_* を呼んでから使う. 【いつ呼ぶか】賃貸・不動産物件の検索（SUUMO/HOMES）が必要なときに呼ぶ。

realestate.name: mcp__realestate__compare_properties
realestate.description:
[USE AFTER search_*] 複数物件を比較する Markdown テーブルを返す.

search_* で取得済みの url 2-5 件を渡す. 家賃 / 間取り / 駅徒歩 / 面積 /
築年 / 住所を縦並びで比較できる. cache 必須. 【いつ呼ぶか】賃貸・不動産物件の検索（SUUMO/HOMES）が必要なときに呼ぶ。

realestate.name: mcp__realestate__save_favorite
realestate.description:
ユーザーが気に入った物件を SQLite に永続保存する.

search_* の結果から url + 任意 note (メモ) を渡す. 後で list_favorites で取り出せる. 【いつ呼ぶか】賃貸・不動産物件の検索（SUUMO/HOMES）が必要なときに呼ぶ。

realestate.name: mcp__realestate__list_favorites
realestate.description:
save_favorite で保存済みの物件一覧を返す.

各エントリに title / rent / address のスナップショットが付く (search 経由で cache 済みなら). 【いつ呼ぶか】賃貸・不動産物件の検索（SUUMO/HOMES）が必要なときに呼ぶ。

nature-remo.name: mcp__nature-remo__list_appliances
nature-remo.description:
登録済み家電の一覧 (id / type / nickname / 送信可能ボタン) を返す。

type ごとに操作 tool が変わる: AC→aircon_control, LIGHT→light_control,
TV→tv_control, その他(IR)→signals を send_signal で送る。
結果は最大 60 秒キャッシュ (レート制限節約)。 【いつ呼ぶか】自宅家電（エアコン・照明等）の操作・状態確認を頼まれたときに呼ぶ。

nature-remo.name: mcp__nature-remo__list_sensors
nature-remo.description:
Remo デバイスのセンサー値 (温度 te / 湿度 hu / 照度 il / 人感 mo) を返す。

複数 Remo があれば全台分。値は newest_events から取り出す。 【いつ呼ぶか】自宅家電（エアコン・照明等）の操作・状態確認を頼まれたときに呼ぶ。

nature-remo.name: mcp__nature-remo__rate_limit_status
nature-remo.description: 直近に観測した Nature API レート制限の残量を返す (新規リクエストはしない)。 【いつ呼ぶか】自宅家電（エアコン・照明等）の操作・状態確認を頼まれたときに呼ぶ。

nature-remo.name: mcp__nature-remo__aircon_control
nature-remo.description:
エアコンを操作する (POST /1/appliances/{id}/aircon_settings)。

Args:
    appliance_id: list_appliances の type=="AC" の id。
    operation_mode: cool / warm / dry / blow / auto のいずれか。電源を入れる時に指定。
    temperature: 設定温度 (例 "26")。その家電の許容レンジ内の文字列。
    air_volume: 風量 (auto / 1.. など、家電依存)。
    air_direction: 風向 (家電依存)。
    button: 電源を切る時は "power-off"。空文字なら他パラメータで運転継続。 【いつ呼ぶか】自宅家電（エアコン・照明等）の操作・状態確認を頼まれたときに呼ぶ。

nature-remo.name: mcp__nature-remo__light_control
nature-remo.description:
照明を操作する (POST /1/appliances/{id}/light)。

Args:
    appliance_id: list_appliances の type=="LIGHT" の id。
    button: "on" / "off" / "on-100" / "night" / "bright-up" / "bright-down" など。
            指定可能な値は list_appliances の light_buttons を参照。 【いつ呼ぶか】自宅家電（エアコン・照明等）の操作・状態確認を頼まれたときに呼ぶ。

nature-remo.name: mcp__nature-remo__tv_control
nature-remo.description:
TV を操作する (POST /1/appliances/{id}/tv)。

Args:
    appliance_id: list_appliances の type=="TV" の id。
    button: "power" / "input" / "vol-up" / "vol-down" / "ch-1".."ch-12" など。
            指定可能な値は list_appliances の tv_buttons を参照。 【いつ呼ぶか】自宅家電（エアコン・照明等）の操作・状態確認を頼まれたときに呼ぶ。

nature-remo.name: mcp__nature-remo__send_signal
nature-remo.description:
任意の登録済み IR シグナルを送信する (POST /1/signals/{id}/send)。

aircon/light/tv 抽象に乗らない家電 (扇風機・プロジェクタ・自作リモコン等) は、
list_appliances の signals[].id をここに渡して送る。 【いつ呼ぶか】自宅家電（エアコン・照明等）の操作・状態確認を頼まれたときに呼ぶ。
